epochs.description: US original-limit 3-session resubmission shadow; advances once per XNYS session with `advance`
H5-LS-ENV-v1 futures demo runner; record_nav stamps a NAV sample every tick. Read from an operator-exported weekly-score snapshot, so RED can also mean the snapshot was not re-exported

TREND-TSMOM-v1 futures demo runner (hk 3796 CT-5 seal); one advance per tick. Read from an operator-exported snapshot of the lane's tick timestamps in the form {"ticks": [{"observed_at": ...}, ...]} (the H5 pattern). No exporter exists yet, so until the operator produces one the epoch reads UNKNOWN (exit 2), never OK
